svg.title: I’m a Junior Cybersecurity Engineer based in Paris, with a focus on protecting sensitive data and understanding how it is accessed. I’m interested in how technical security and organizational decisions work together to protect information and systems. My work involves monitoring access to sensitive information, improving detection and supporting security investigations. I’m also interested in development and automation as ways to simplify recurring tasks and make security processes more effective. My interests span offensive and defensive security, as well as governance, risk and compliance. I enjoy understanding how systems work, connecting technical issues to their wider impact, and turning what I learn into practical improvements.
